summary: Blue Owl Credit Income Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a routine monthly unregistered sale of 117,762 Class I shares for $1,077,521 under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S and declaring a standard monthly distribution across three share classes. There is no M&A event, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation. The filing is a regular capital-raising and dividend activity for a BDC.
